correctness.rationale: I reconstructed the all-real, all-length proof. Both signs in a common alphabet of size at most three leave at most one unequal same-sign value pair u>v. Equality of totals gives equally many of its two orientations, so assigning each unequal item to the higher valuer produces the same nonnegative own-bundle comparison advantage Δ for both agents. For tied items the signed lower-sum-for-goods/higher-sum-for-chores rule reduces the magnitude when the sign of the difference is preserved; on a strict crossing or departure from zero the new item supplies the correct-side deletion witness. Thus either positive total envy gap is at most the magnitude of the signed common-item difference, which one legal deletion can repair. The source's strict d>E₂ (and symmetric inequality) can be equality at Δ=0; the weak inequality suffices. Itemwise maximization proves utilitarian optimality, including for negative unequal values; the scan takes linear arithmetic operations, and the optimum is at least 1 by allocating everything to either agent. Independently for Teh's family in units of 1/3, write s for agent 1's number of ordinary goods minus ordinary chores, and z∈{0,1} for receipt of the balancing good. Welfare is 3+s−z and agent 2's envy gap is 2(s+2z)−3. Even the largest legal deletion (at most 1 when z=0 and 2 when z=1) forces s≤2 or s≤0, respectively. The value 5 is realized with two ordinary goods and no chores or balancing good for agent 1; unrestricted welfare k+4 is itemwise optimal. Both agent totals equal 3 in these units.
residual_risks: Linear bound is in arithmetic/comparison operations, not a bit-complexity guarantee.

value.rationale: Zero loss versus unbounded loss is a meaningful sharp threshold for the price of EF1 in the same normalized sign-agreeing model. The proof isolates why the single directed comparison type can be assigned efficiently without sacrificing fairness, and makes a linear constructive guarantee, not just existence. It does not re-claim the four-level witness.
residual_risks: The guarantee is deliberately limited to two agents and the common three-level alphabet.
